messages.content: Compile the CURRENT public rule task into the seven-field structured program in the response schema: bindings, observations, rule_residuals, nodes, scopes, clauses, query. Declare public inputs and unresolved factual/legal predicates first, then local computations, scopes, guarded clauses and the final query. Empty declaration arrays are allowed when no such input is used. Use the actual JSON AST, not Python, function-call text, code strings, a native answer or a coverage claim. No tools or grading information are available. Internal names are unique ASCII identifiers of at most64 characters across all declarations; a name has no implicit semantic meaning. Provenance uses exact sN unit IDs; task_id is logging metadata and never a valid unit ID or operand. Binding evidence and clause ownership list each actual source unit at most once. These are finite source sets, not repeated sequences. Never repeat source IDs to fill an array. Do not enumerate source paragraphs into primitive inputs or repeat a declaration. Primitive inputs are bindings records {name,type,sources,value}, following language_contract. Every numeric value and public string must be grounded in the cited units. A relation has actual factual witness rows, one cell per column, citing all required factual lines. Source IDs are metadata, never relation cells, numerical inputs or legal citations. Boolean primitives require literal true/false in the cited text; paragraph numbers, years and0/1 are not truth values. Observations have unique names beginning b_, an exact entity quote and factual entity_source, and an exact predicate quote and rule predicate_source. You do not provide their truth values in the program. Reuse one observation for identical quotes. Legal effects, thresholds, arithmetic, dates and comparisons belong in executable expressions, not factual observations. Untranslated proper legal/numeric subexpressions may use rule_residuals with unique b_ names, an actual rule source and exact proper subquote. They retain both False/True and are never sent to the fact observer. The containing clause or scope must actually read them. Do not replace an entire rule, final claim or numerical comparison with a guessed fact or Boolean. scopes is keyed by every actual rule unit ID. Each entry is null or {name,condition}; condition is a Boolean AST. Null means no accepted scope translation, retaining the existing unknown scope; it never means false. Use null for units that need no separate scope or whose scope is untranslated. Only nonconditional structural titles may use literal true. Supply executable conditions for all required_scope_sources before claiming their context covered, including conditional prefaces. The fixed scope keys do not themselves translate or cover any rule. clauses contains {name,sources,value,otherwise}. Own only the rule units actually translated. The engine physically guards each output using every inherited scope in the transitive source context. State the disabled value explicitly and with the proper type; do not guess it. A reference, unused scope or local calculation cannot cover an untranslated rule. Partial translations leave unowned units unknown. The full policy requires residual source to be parsed before certification; answer_separating selects remaining source using the actual completion check, never by guessing away unknown effects. Read a declared symbol with {"var":"its_declared_name"}; a string is a literal, not a variable or a request to read a source unit. Names and source IDs are not executable facts. An expression is a JSON integer, string, boolean or null, a variable object with exactly key var, or an operation object with exactly keys op and args. args is an array of operand expressions. Operations are if, not, xor, eq, ne, lt, le, sub, scale, divide_constant, ceil_divide_constant, number_at, min, max, and, or, add, array, pair, object, concat. if has exactly three operands: Boolean condition, then value, else value. and/or take separate Boolean expressions in args, never an array expression as one Boolean operand. Empty and/or are supported. All branches must type check. scale requires a literal integer multiplier first; divide_constant and ceil_divide_constant require the numeric expression first and a nonzero/positive literal denominator second. number_at takes a numeric vector and nonnegative literal integer index, without an out-of-range default. pair takes exactly two operands: a string key first, then its value. object takes separate pair expressions as args. A record/pair/string array is not a numeric vector. A denominator100 for percent or2 for one-half is only the stated conversion, not a new amount. Local expression nodes contain {name,kind:expression,body:AST}. Connector nodes contain {name,kind:connector,body:{graph,project}}, using the seven graph operators and actual parameter shapes in language_contract. Projections are identity, amount_value, amount_values and entailment_label. When an available learned graph matches the actual slot/column obligations, use its pattern hash, variant and complete slots/columns mapping. Copying its operators is not library use. Do not insert irrelevant graph calls to claim reuse. Every consumption of one allowance bank shares one thread_allowance result; never clone or re-consume its bank. Read allocations from that single amount_values output. Expressions and graphs have at most16 nested operations; factor longer calculations into named nodes. The final query combines guarded clause outputs and public inputs into language_contract.query_result_schema. Do not bypass guards through a helper or scope name, and do not return a constant native result. Do not invent laws, witnesses, dates, amounts or missing operators. Timing policies are not executable date comparisons; use supported numeric expressions or retain proper unknown legal subexpressions. accepted_program is the previously accepted translation. Preserve unchanged names, quotations and definitions to retain factual evidence. validation_feedback is source-only diagnosis, never target answers. Repair concrete errors without coercion or invented rules.  Compilation policy: answer_separating. Interface policy: collision_refined.
